verdict.rationale: Obsidian publishes an official TypeScript plugin API (obsidianmd/obsidian-api, exposing interfaces such as Vault for file and folder access). It also has official developer docs and a build-a-sample-plugin tutorial, so developers can build against a first-party SDK. Missing for 10: any SDK beyond in-app TypeScript plugins (no multi-language or remote/service SDK for external agents), in-depth API reference coverage in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with it.
